blocks.text: Hosea 5 contains 15 verses. It opens with: Hear this, O ye priests, and hearken, O house of Israel, and give ear, O house of the king; for unto you pertaineth the judgment; for ye have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor. It concludes with: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me earnestly.
